name: Motel (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Two-storey motel, 36 x 12 m: a 33 m block of rooms in render and brick, every room with its door and window facing the front onto an exterior walkway (paved below, a concrete deck with glass-and-aluminium railings above on steel posts, a canopy over), an open precast stair at each end with glass guards up to the upper walkway, a parking strip with bay lines and wheel stops in front. The reception office is at the west end (glazed front, counter, back office). Fifteen guest rooms, each a bedroom with a bathroom behind; through-wall air-conditioning grilles under the windows.
